name: thread-cleaner
description: Automatically archives or locks threads after a configurable period of inactivity.
endUserDataStatement: Does not collect or store personal end-user data. Stores thread IDs and cleanup metadata.

configFields.label: Enabled Channels
configFields.description: Channels where new threads should be scheduled for cleanup.

configFields.label: Inactivity Duration
configFields.description: Duration of inactivity before cleanup runs (e.g. 24h, 3d).

configFields.label: Cleanup Action
configFields.description: Action to perform on inactive threads.

author: Lumi Developers
end_user_data_statement: Does not collect or store personal end-user data. Stores thread IDs and cleanup metadata.
